decisions.review: Still sound for the selected cases. The real reader tests show distinct choices and visible supported content; neither test generalizes to all features. No new normative test is justified by Annex I's discretionary wording.

decisions.topic: I.2 warning text, insertion version, first-error recommendation
decisions.review: The current code carries both warning clauses, raises version on insertion, and preserves the deliberate first-error recommendation departure. A834 item 4 ratifies reporting every unrecognized feature. The source says SHOULD for suppression, so this is an owner-backed recommendation choice, not a required defect. Caution: durable ledger wording that says the newer-version notice occurs before any page is drawn is stale; the host asks for Report after first frame. Annex I does not prescribe a stricter report timing, so this is documentation precision rather than a conformance failure.

decisions.topic: K.1 notice and static/dynamic XFA boundary
decisions.review: The distinction remains supported: a real hybrid is identified to the host and its AcroForm/XFA behavior is described; the permission to omit schema-generated pages is expressly reported. The checked-in public test exercises the host report, not merely a private message helper.

ADR 2876 supersedes the earlier dynamic-XFA exclusion: dynamic page generation is accepted and scheduled after ledger work, but is not yet built. K.1 permits a processor to omit schema-driven page generation, and that interim permission is currently exercised; record this as scheduled work rather than a scope exclusion. Keep the implementation's current fallback pages and report distinct from any claim that XFA-generated pages were materialized.
